page.title: AI Metrics
page.description: How many AI proposals were accepted or dismissed, and how often calls to each AI provider were sent, delayed or refused by rate limits.

outbound.title: Provider rate limits
outbound.description: Outbound egress counters tracked per AI provider over the selected window.

column.help: Allowed: sent right away. Waited: delayed by the rate limiter, then sent. Denied: refused because the limit was exceeded.
